name: City Park
desc1: This park was once beautiful, with flowers of every sort cultivated in
desc2: small circular patches throughout the great lawns.  In the center of
desc3: the park is a small pond that held ducks and swans.  The grass is now
desc4: frozen, the plants are a sickly shade of green under the snow, and the
desc5: pond is so full of grease and murk that it cannot be frozen.  The air
desc6: is think with the sharp stench of rot.
